reviews.text: Very quirky over the shoulder survival horror on an arctic train ride. Includes a really intriuging aspect of enemies interacting with each other - looking forward to learn more!
A distress signal from the Antarctic research station leads a paranormal agent, Doug Barker, to investigate. Survive against interdimensional horrors & don't let the train stop... or freeze trying!
🦴 | It can't be judged harshly while in its early stages. Although not my cup of tea the overall design draws the eye to all the lights and buttons you can press. 5/10
Dog mascot fighting teddy bears on an Antarctic research train. Great premise, great enemies, outside sections with heat pads are the game at its best. Controls need work. Maybe.
A third-person survival horror game where players explore a monster-infested train in Antarctica while managing resources and avoiding dangers
[FESS Mini] Riding on a train through Antarctica, uncover the reason behind the distress signal aboard the mobile research station and face off against the creatures who now inhabit it.
